title: KEEP_DELIBERATE_LAYER_SWARM_NOT_UNIVERSAL
finding: Swarm intelligence is powerful but NOT universal. Problems requiring central coordination, long-term planning, or symbolic reasoning don't decompose into local interactions. 'You can't solve differential equations with ant trails.' (ideasthesia.org 2026; Bonabeau et al. 1999)
implication_for_ob1: Our pheromone/stigmergy layer handles parallel exploration + coordination beautifully. But we MUST keep a DELIBERATE layer for non-decomposable problems: the operator's option-4 (step back, retrace, ask questions, systematic learn), RISE/DEATH audit, and the SOUL redefinition overrides. Don't try to swarm everything.
mapping: STIGMERGIC LAYER = nonstop pheromones, ant-colony coordination, parallel scent-laying. DELIBERATE LAYER = RISE audit, DEATH seal, operator's option-4 retrace, canonical overrides. Both required; the mold says so.

negative_trails.failure: Assume pheromone/stigmergy alone solves all problems including symbolic/long-term/central ones.
negative_trails.root_cause: Over-applying the ant mold beyond its domain (parallel exploration + local feedback).

positive_trails.action: Use stigmergy for coordination/exploration; deliberate layer (RISE/DEATH/option-4) for symbolic/long-term. Both, not either.
positive_trails.verification: ideasthesia.org Swarm Intelligence 2026; Bonabeau Dorigo Theraulaz 1999.
